mapper.select: select f.id as form_id, f.code, f.title, f.description, f.closing_text, f.total_questions, f.status, f.create_time, count(a.id) as sent_count, sum(case when a.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as answered_count from survey_form f left join survey_assignment a on a.form_id = f.id where f.id = #{formId} group by f.id, f.code, f.title, f.description, f.closing_text, f.total_questions, f.status, f.create_time
select count(1) from survey_form where id = #{formId} and status = 1
select count(1) from lectures where id = #{lectureId}

select id, form_id, parent_question_id, question_no, section_title, question_type, content, input_placeholder, required_flag, sort_order, status from survey_question where form_id = #{formId} and status = 1 order by sort_order, id

select o.id, o.question_id, o.option_value, o.option_label, o.allow_text_input, o.sort_order, o.status from survey_question_option o join survey_question q on q.id = o.question_id where q.form_id = #{formId} and o.status = 1 order by o.question_id, o.sort_order, o.id

select distinct l.id as course_id, l.name as course_name, l.time as course_time from survey_assignment a join lectures l on l.id = a.lecture_id join survey_form f on f.id = a.form_id and f.status = 1 where a.user_info_id = #{userInfoId} order by l.time desc, l.id desc

select a.id as assignment_id, f.id as form_id, f.title, f.description, f.total_questions, a.status, case when a.status = 1 then '已提交' else '未提交' end as status_label, a.assigned_at, a.submitted_at from survey_assignment a join survey_form f on f.id = a.form_id and f.status = 1 where a.user_info_id = #{userInfoId} and a.lecture_id = #{courseId} order by a.id desc
select id, form_id, lecture_id, user_info_id, wx_user_id, status, submission_id, assigned_by, assigned_at, submitted_at, create_time, update_time from survey_assignment where id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into survey_assignment (form_id, lecture_id, user_info_id, wx_user_id, status, assigned_by, assigned_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{formId}, #{lectureId}, #{userInfoId}, #{wxUserId}, #{status}, #{assignedBy}, #{assignedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into survey_submission (form_id, user_info_id, wx_user_id, status, submitted_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{formId}, #{userInfoId}, #{wxUserId}, #{status}, #{submittedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into survey_answer (submission_id, question_id, answer_value, answer_text, create_time, update_time) values (#{submissionId}, #{questionId}, #{answerValue}, #{answerText}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select id as user_info_id, user_id, user_name, real_name, phone from user_info
and (phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by id desc

select a.id as assignment_id, a.form_id, l.id as course_id, l.name as course_name, u.id as user_info_id, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.real_name, u.phone, a.status, case when a.status = 1 then '已提交' else '未提交' end as status_label, a.assigned_at, a.submitted_at from survey_assignment a join lectures l on l.id = a.lecture_id join user_info u on u.id = a.user_info_id where a.id = #{assignmentId}

select q.id as question_id, q.question_no, q.section_title, q.question_type, q.content as question_content, cast(a.answer_value as char) as answer_value, a.answer_text from survey_answer a join survey_question q on q.id = a.question_id where a.submission_id = #{submissionId} order by q.sort_order, q.id
